units.source_text: 我一边观察这种明朗的焚香仪式，一边苦苦思索：

en.t: As I watched this bright and open incense-burning ceremony, I pondered painfully:

units.source_text: 倘使我继嗣鹿苑寺，在献嗣香的时候，能按惯例宣告老师的名字吗？

en.t: If I were to inherit Rokuonji, when offering the succession incense, could I announce my teacher's name according to custom?

units.source_text: 也许我会打破七百年来的惯例，宣告别的名字吧。

en.t: Perhaps I would break a custom of seven hundred years and announce another name instead.

units.source_text: 早春的下午，方丈室冷飕飕的，室内弥漫着五种香的香气，

en.t: On an early spring afternoon, the abbot's chamber was chilly, and the room was filled with the fragrance of five kinds of incense,

units.source_text: 摆在佛具后面的闪闪发光的璎珞、绕在主佛像背后的灿烂夺目的光环、并列而坐的僧侣们的袈裟色彩……

en.t: the glittering jeweled ornaments placed behind the Buddhist implements, the dazzling halo encircling the back of the main Buddha image, the colors of the robes of the monks seated side by side...

units.source_text: 我幻想着假如有一天我也能在那里焚上嗣法昏……

en.t: I imagined that one day I too might burn the incense of Dharma succession there...

units.source_text: 我在心里描绘着我变成了新任住持的形象。

en.t: In my mind, I pictured myself becoming the newly appointed abbot.
